crm_rows.suggested_play: Your Mariah Carey 'It's Time!' video premiered on a Times Square billboard in early November alongside the Savings Event through November 10. You likely cannot see how many billboard viewers acted on it. A Flowcode on OOH creative could link to a Savings Event or gifting page, with a branded FlowURL for the social posts. You would get scans by location and time, and a comparison of OOH against social. How do you attribute billboard exposure to sales or app activity today?
crm_rows.would_measure: Scans by billboard and time; clicks to Savings Event and gifting pages; OOH versus social response.

crm_rows.title: F1 Academy Glam Bars: capture guests at 18 Grands Prix
crm_rows.what_happening: Sephora is the official F1 Academy partner, running glam bars and fan activations at select races (including Austin) and Glam Bars for Paddock Club guests at 18 Grands Prix.
crm_rows.why_flowcode_fits: Glam Bars serve many guests across races and countries, yet guests likely leave without being linked to Sephora's CRM. A code at each bar could capture them and show results by race.
crm_rows.suggested_play: Your Glam Bars are at 18 Grands Prix through the 2026 season for Paddock Club guests, plus F1 Academy fan activations. You likely do not capture who visited each bar or connect them to Beauty Insider. A Flowcode at each bar could open a FlowHub with a sign-up, a booking for a look and a post-event offer. You would get scans and sign-ups by race and country. Flowcode's CLEAR deployment drove 1.2M+ scans across 7,000+ codes. How do you follow up with Glam Bar guests after a race weekend?
crm_rows.would_measure: Scans per race; sign-ups; Glam Bar bookings; follow-up offer redemption.

crm_rows.title: Dancing with the Stars official beauty partner: broadcast response
crm_rows.what_happening: Sephora is Official Beauty Partner of Dancing with the Stars with on-air integrations, vanity stations for the audience and a cast 'last looks' activation.
crm_rows.why_flowcode_fits: On-air integrations reach a cross-generational audience, but viewer response is likely unmeasured. A code in segments or on vanity stations could link broadcast to sign-ups.
crm_rows.suggested_play: Your Dancing with the Stars partnership, announced in September, puts Sephora on air and at on-site vanity stations. You likely cannot tell which integrations lead viewers to Sephora. A Flowcode on screen during Sephora segments and on the vanity stations could open a FlowHub with the looks featured and a Beauty Insider sign-up. You would get scans per episode and segment, plus live-audience sign-ups. How do you measure viewer response to this partnership now?
crm_rows.would_measure: Scans per episode and segment; sign-ups; clicks to featured products; studio audience versus TV viewers.
